cover.title: Christian McBride & Ursa Major
cover.calloutLabel: A note from CEO of Vivo Performing Arts
cover.pressQuote: "McBride's clarity of sound, the bullet-like impact he imparts to every note at any speed, and the distinctive turns of his lines, make him one of the most remarkable bassists in post-bop." The Guardian

sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: The 11-time Grammy-winning superstar bassist and four rising stars build irresistible grooves and dazzle with explosive solos in music that's sometimes swinging, sometimes funky, and always easy to like.
body: CHRISTIAN MCBRIDE bass NICOLE GLOVER tenor saxophone ELY PERLMAN guitar MIKE KING piano SAVANNAH HARRIS drums The warmth, charisma, and joy of performance is a tangible delight when Christian McBride and Ursa Major perform together. The 11-time Grammy-winning superstar bassist and four rising stars have become what McBride calls an "all-in" band that can "go anywhere, musically." McBride and Ursa Major build irresistible grooves and dazzle with explosive solos in music that's sometimes swinging, sometimes funky, and always easy to like.

body: Vivo Performing Arts gathers and performs on the unceded ancestral lands of the Massachusett, Pawtucket, and Wampanoag peoples.
Assistive listening devices are available. For ASL or audio description on selected performances, contact access@vivoperformingarts.org at least one week in advance.
